notes:
August 11th 2026
Version 13.3+ (stable) / 13.4+ (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Press Ctrl+R anywhere to report a bug — your open files and diagnostics attach automatically. (K,R)
* New "Copy to Clipboard" in Print/Export — paste the program list straight into Excel or Word. (R)
* Right-click menus reorganized into logical submenus, so it's easier to find what you need. (K,R)
* Right-click menu text is now larger and easier to read. (K,R)
* See Help->Show Release Notes for More...

Version 13.3+ (stable) / 13.4+ (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Added feature to convert/fix non-playable AUDIO files[wav,mp3]. (R,K)

* Revised/Updated the K-Configurator Users Manual. (K,R)
